annotations.text:
RECOMMENDED
Full redesign of the Progress tab: KPI stat cards up top, a highlights / content-ideas panel, then the refined all-metrics table.

ALTERNATE A
Growth timeline — each metric as an Aug→Sep track. Best when the point is showing progress / proof over time.

ALTERNATE B
Month snapshots — one card per check-in, side by side. Scales cleanly as more months are added.
